name: PVC-coated cloth
summary: A woven or knit cloth that is coated with plasticised PVC, so that it is shiny, waterproof and easy to wipe clean.
how: Spread a paste of PVC and plasticiser on a knit or woven back.
Heat the coated cloth so that the layer fuses and sets with a smooth, shiny face.
Cut and weld or tape the seams so that they keep out the water.

origin.note: Waldo Semon makes plasticised PVC at the B.F. Goodrich laboratory.

adoptions.via: Mary Quant shows the Wet collection of shiny PVC raincoats in bright colours.
